# Human Not Required

> The world's first agent-only store. Humans can browse the storefront, but only AI agents can place orders. An agent pays directly from its own wallet — no human checkout, no account, no saved card.

## API
- Base URL: https://web-production-77376.up.railway.app
- OpenAPI spec: https://web-production-77376.up.railway.app/.well-known/openapi.json
- Agent discovery: https://web-production-77376.up.railway.app/.well-known/agent.json
- Payment manifest (live price + network): https://web-production-77376.up.railway.app/.well-known/payment-manifest.json

## How to buy
The ONLY order endpoint is `POST /checkout`. There is no registration, no API key, and no card flow. Two ways to pay:

### Pay with x402 (USDC on Base — fully agent-native)
Requires: an EVM wallet on Base with USDC, and any x402 v2 client (e.g. @x402/fetch).
1. POST /checkout with { sku, name, email, address } and Content-Type: application/json — with no payment header.
2. Server returns 402 with a `Payment-Required` response header (base64 JSON, x402 v2) carrying `accepts[]`.
3. Agent signs an EIP-3009 `TransferWithAuthorization` for the USDC amount and retries the same request with the payment header (`PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` for x402 v2, or `X-PAYMENT` for v1).
4. USDC settles on Base and the hat ships automatically. No human involvement ever.
- Read the live network, USDC contract, amount, and payee from the 402 envelope (or the payment manifest) — never hard-code them. The store runs Base Sepolia (testnet) by default and flips to Base mainnet for production pricing.
- Payment is captured only after /checkout returns 2xx. A 502 (`fulfillment_failed`) means no USDC was captured — safe to retry. Idempotency is keyed on the payment nonce: replaying the same signed authorization returns your original order, not a second hat.

### Pay with a promo code (free)
1. POST /checkout with { sku, name, email, address, promo_code } and no payment header.
2. A valid code places a free order; an invalid or exhausted code returns 400/409 with no charge.
- Do not send both a promo_code and an x402 payment — that is rejected as `ambiguous_payment`.

## Available products
- sku: hat-myagent-os — "My Agent Bought Me This" Embroidered Hat — One Size
  - Price + network are single-sourced server-side. Call GET /orders/skus or read the payment manifest for the live USDC price.

## Auth
None. The signed x402 payment IS the authorization. There is no Bearer token and no POST /register.

## Limits
- No human checkout — the storefront has no buy button; only the agent API can order.
- Promo attempts are throttled per IP. An optional per-email daily x402 cap can be enabled by the operator (returns 429 when exceeded).

## Store
- Storefront: https://humannotrequired.com
- Built by: @nft_leen
